mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hospital_all_list ( hospital_name, hospital_addr, hospital_class_code, hospital_class_name, hospital_site, hospital_tel, hospital_lon, hospital_lat, created_at ) VALUES ( #{h_name}, #{h_addr}, #{h_class}, #{h_class_name}, #{h_site}, #{h_tel}, #{h_lon}, #{h_lat}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hospital_addr = #{h_addr}, hospital_class_code = #{h_class}, hospital_class_name = #{h_class_name}, hospital_site = #{h_site}, hospital_lon = #{h_lon}, hospital_lat = #{h_lat}, updated_at = NOW()
